title: BPS Recommended Benefit Category Vocabulary
description: Non-normative recommended values for the `category` field on `benefits[]`. Categories are uppercase snake_case to remain visually distinct from canonical_key (lowercase snake_case). Adopters MAY extend; carrier-specific or proprietary categories should ideally map to one of these.

categories.label: Physician services
categories.description: Office visits, primary care, specialist, and other professional medical services.

categories.label: Preventive care
categories.description: ACA-mandated preventive services including well visits, screenings, immunizations.

categories.label: Diagnostic services
categories.description: Laboratory, imaging, and diagnostic tests.

categories.label: Emergency care
categories.description: Emergency room services, ambulance, and emergency transport.

categories.label: Urgent care
categories.description: Urgent care center visits.

categories.label: Hospital services
categories.description: Inpatient and outpatient hospital services, observation, and ER facility fees.

categories.label: Surgical services
categories.description: Inpatient and outpatient surgery (facility and professional components).

categories.label: Maternity care
categories.description: Prenatal, delivery, postnatal, and newborn services.

categories.label: Behavioral health
categories.description: Mental health, substance use disorder, and autism services.

categories.label: Rehabilitation services
categories.description: Physical, occupational, speech, cardiac, and pulmonary therapy; habilitative services.

categories.label: Home health services
categories.description: Home-based skilled nursing, aides, therapies, and hospice.

categories.label: Skilled nursing facility
categories.description: Skilled nursing facility care.

categories.label: Prescription drugs
categories.description: Prescription drug benefits by formulary tier.

categories.label: Durable medical equipment
categories.description: DME, prosthetics, orthotics, oxygen, and diabetic supplies.

categories.label: Dialysis
categories.description: Kidney dialysis services.

categories.label: Chemotherapy
categories.description: Chemotherapy and oncology infusion services.

categories.label: Radiation therapy
categories.description: Radiation oncology services.

categories.label: Bariatric surgery
categories.description: Weight loss surgery.

categories.label: Infertility services
categories.description: Diagnosis and treatment of infertility.

categories.label: Chiropractic care
categories.description: Chiropractic services.

categories.label: Acupuncture
categories.description: Acupuncture services.

categories.label: Telehealth
categories.description: Virtual/telehealth visits.

categories.label: Pediatric vision
categories.description: Pediatric eye exams and corrective lenses (ACA essential benefit).

categories.label: Pediatric dental
categories.description: Pediatric dental services (ACA essential benefit).

categories.label: Excluded services
categories.description: Services explicitly not covered by the plan.
